items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-16
items.q: Like one time when Bach was, oh, was raging, one of the boppers made a remark...

ctx.x: That's it. The youngsters nowadays, what can they do to learn music? You don't have jam sessions like we used to have. What are we going to do?

Well, they don't want to, they don't want to even associate a man like you and myself that's been playing a long time. That's because we dated, uh, long hair to an extent. Like one time when Bach was, oh, was raging, one of the boppers made a remark that they love song don't make, you know, they don't make enough notes.
How's a kid going to learn to play jazz now?
